changes_from_deliverable_1: Added the Physical Refrigerator Contents external entity (E4) and its data flow (F7). The cameras and sensors are inside the system boundary, so the items they observe are the source of that data. Without E4, on-device capture had no input source.

system.name: Smart Inventory Fridge System
system.description: IoT-enabled refrigerator (simulated) and its supporting cloud platform. The fridge sends raw row readings and shelf images to the cloud (ADR-001). The cloud runs image recognition and handles inventory, expiry tracking, alerts, dashboards, and reports.

external_entities.name: Kitchen Inventory Staff
external_entities.description: Staff who stock and use refrigerated items day to day. They confirm details the system cannot detect and respond to expiry and low-stock alerts.

external_entities.name: Purchasing Staff
external_entities.description: Staff who decide what to reorder, based on stock levels and usage history.

external_entities.name: Manager
external_entities.description: Configures alert thresholds and notification preferences, and reviews inventory and usage reports.

external_entities.name: Physical Refrigerator Contents
external_entities.description: The physical items stored in the refrigerator. The system observes them through cameras and shelf weight sensors. In this project, a simulator generates these observations.

data_flows.label: Item details, expiry dates, inventory corrections, inventory queries, waste entries

data.name: item_details
data.description: Details of an item the system could not identify automatically, provided or confirmed by staff.

data.name: expiry_date
data.description: Expiry date for a stock lot, entered when it cannot be read from the package.

data.name: inventory_correction
data.description: Manual correction to a detected quantity or item.

example.reason: two tubs hidden behind milk cartons

data.name: inventory_query
data.description: Request to view current inventory, optionally filtered.

data.name: waste_entry
data.description: Staff log an item that was thrown out instead of used, with the reason.

data_flows.label: Current inventory, expiry warnings, low-stock notifications
data_flows.trigger: On query, or pushed when an alert condition is met

data.name: current_inventory
data.description: Snapshot of the items in a refrigerator, with quantities and expiry status.

data.name: expiry_warning
data.description: Alert that a stock lot is close to its expiry date or past it.

data.name: low_stock_notification
data.description: Alert that an item's quantity is at or below its low-stock threshold.

data.name: stock_query
data.description: Request for current stock levels across one or more refrigerators.

data.name: usage_query
data.description: Request for consumption and waste history for a product over a period.

data_flows.label: Stock levels, low-stock information, usage information
data_flows.trigger: In response to a stock or usage query

data.name: stock_levels
data.description: Current quantity and threshold for each product.

data.name: low_stock_information
data.description: Products currently at or below their low-stock threshold.

data.name: usage_information
data.description: Consumed and wasted quantities for a product over a period.

data_flows.label: Alert thresholds, notification preferences, report requests, alert clearances, user accounts

data.name: alert_threshold
data.description: Low-stock threshold and expiry warning window for a product.

data.name: notification_preferences
data.description: Which alerts are delivered, to which roles, and through which channels.

data.name: report_request
data.description: Request to generate an inventory or usage report.

data.name: alert_clearance
data.description: Manager clears an alert after it has been dealt with. Alerts stay active until they are cleared.

data.name: user_account
data.description: Add, change, or deactivate a staff member who uses the dashboard and receives alerts.

data_flows.label: Inventory reports, usage reports, alerts, settings confirmation
data_flows.trigger: On request, or pushed when an alert condition is met

data.name: inventory_report
data.description: Point-in-time summary of stock levels and expiry status.

data.name: usage_report
data.description: Consumption and waste trends over a period.

data.name: alert
data.description: Expiry or low-stock alert, delivered according to the notification preferences.

data.name: settings_confirmation
data.description: Confirmation that threshold or preference changes were saved.

data_flows.label: Item images, shelf weight readings
data_flows.trigger: Captured each time the refrigerator door closes

data.name: item_image
data.description: Camera frame of a shelf. In this project, the simulator generates it as a ground-truth list of items, with configurable occlusion and noise.

data.name: shelf_weight_reading
data.description: Total weight on a shelf from its load sensor. In this project, the simulator generates it with configurable sensor noise.
